Delay before each Voidling is summoned

mechanics.claim: The active consumes all stacks after a 0.5-second delay before the first Voidling appears, and additional Voidlings from consumed stacks are summoned sequentially, each 0.5 seconds after the previous.
mechanics.quote: after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay, summons a {{ui|Voidling}} at the target location. Additional ''Voidlings'' are then summoned for each ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack consumed, with each ''Voidling'' being summoned {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the previous one.

mechanics.claim: Malzahar generates a Zz'Rot Swarm stack whenever he casts another ability, up to the cap, meaning Q/E casts build toward extra Voidlings on the next W.
mechanics.quote: '''Malzahar''' generates a stack of ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' when he casts another {{tip|ability}}, up to a maximum of 2.

mechanics.claim: Stacks are granted per cast attempt, not per successful activation - even a cancelled ability cast still grants a stack.
mechanics.quote: ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks are gained per cast and not per ability activation. For example, if {{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}} is cast and the ability cancels under certain circumstances, a ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack will still be granted despite the ability's failure to complete.

mechanics.claim: All accumulated Zz'Rot Swarm stacks are lost when Malzahar dies.
Voidling attack damage is reduced against epic monsters and increased against enemy minions infected by Malefic Visions; neither epic monsters nor minions are present in the simulated fights.
mechanics.quote: reduced by 50% against epic {{tip|monsters}} and increased by 200% to enemy {{tip|minions}} infected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}''
